title: Lanework board
description: A board root's `index.md` — the document the `.lanework` package is named for.

schema.description: Always 1. Required at the board root; below it a missing value reads as 1.

title.description: The board's display name. Absent falls back to the folder name, sans extension.

kind.description: `board`. Written at creation; redundant with position everywhere but the trash.

created.description: When the board was filed, and by whom.

modified.description: The last app write that rewrote this file's content. Order-only rewrites do not stamp.

icon.description: The board's SF Symbol and the tint it wears.

id.description: The board's own identity, and the host of every `lanework://` link. Minted on open when absent, never rewritten once present.

show-card-body.description: How many lines of a card's first plain paragraph the face previews: `0` (off, the default) or 2–5. A reading outside the set is clamped into it.

due-soon.description: How many days ahead a `due` date wears the amber chip. Default 1 — today and tomorrow; a hand-written 0 means today alone. Negative clamps to 0.

priorities.description: Reserved since 2026-09-07: not read. A board carrying it drops it, unconverted, on its next `index.md` rewrite. The one-time migration is its only reader.

labels.description: The board's whole label-kind vocabulary beyond the built-in `text` kind. Nothing on the machine adds to it.

thumb-sizes.description: The board's thumbnail size roster; overrides the global one, which overrides the built-in [200, 400].

short-id.description: Whether a card's face carries its short id (the first eight characters of its uuid): `show` (always), `option` (while ⌥ alone is held) or `hide`. Absent inherits this Mac's value, then hide; `true` reads show and `false` reads hide, and a value with no reading is treated as absent and keeps its bytes.

show-statusbar.description: Shows the board window's status bar. Absent is hidden, and the app removes the subkey rather than writing false.

show-trash.description: Puts the trash column on screen as the board's last lane. Absent is hidden; the app removes the subkey rather than writing false.

move-receipts.description: Has the app write a move receipt: one quiet comment, carrying `moved`, on a card moved to another lane in the app. Absent is off; the app removes the subkey rather than writing false.

perspective.description: Which perspective the window presents — `kanban` (the default, absent) or a name a later version draws. An unknown name reads as kanban and keeps its bytes.

logging.description: The board log's own level and retention.

config.description: The board's settings block. Written per subkey: every sibling rides through untouched, and the last subkey leaving removes the mapping.

template.description: Picker metadata when this board lives in a template store (09-templates.md). Read by the template store, not modeled by BoardModel; carried onto instantiated boards, where it rides along inert like any unknown key.

workspace.description: Reserved (owner ruling 2026-11-09): neither read nor written. A board carrying it keeps its bytes.

show-trash.description: Retired: folded into `config.show-trash` on the board's next write. The mapping wins where both exist.

iconColor.description: Retired: folded into `icon.color` on the next icon-touching write. The mapping wins per property.

modified-by.description: Retired: folds into `modified.by`. The map wins where both are present.

author.description: Reserved: never written. Folds into `created.by` as `{name: …}` by a scheduled heal at every level.

deleted.description: Retired: the tombstone model. At a board root a present key is ignored and logged.
